preconditions.description: The input integer n must be a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: all(square in [i*i for i in range(1, int(n**0.5) + 1)] for square in squares) and sum(squares) == n and len(squares) == return_value
postconditions.description: The returned integer is the smallest number of perfect squares (squares) such that their sum equals n. The squares must be positive perfect squares (1, 4, 9, ...).

postconditions.expression: not any(square < 1 for square in squares) and all(square == i*i for square in squares for i in range(1, int(n**0.5) + 1))
postconditions.description: All elements in the set of squares must be valid perfect squares (1, 4, 9, ...).
